# President's Work

> Strategic brand consultancy and creative studio helping founders and leadership teams find what is unclear, fix what is holding the brand back, and build the brand their business needs next.

President's Work works with businesses during moments of creation, growth and change. The consultancy helps leadership understand what is changing inside the business, make the decisions the brand depends on, and turn those decisions into a clear strategy, message, identity and direction.

The approach is inside-out: clarity before creativity. Positioning comes before the logo, audience understanding comes before messaging, and decisions come before execution.

## Company and founder

- Name: President's Work
- Website: https://www.presidentswork.com/
- Clients: 220+ brands
- Founder: Yanky Perl
- Founder role: Brand strategist and creative director; author of the book Building Nothing
- Positioning: Strategic brand consultancy and creative studio
- Brand line: Leading brands into power©
- Principle: Lead with intent, insight and purpose.
- Audiences: Founders and leadership teams
- Contact: hello@presidentswork.com, 347-968-4593
- Book a call: https://www.presidentswork.com/contact

## Who President's Work helps

### Founders

For founders who are launching something new, clarifying what they have built, changing direction, growing, or realizing that their current brand has fallen behind the vision.

### Leadership teams

For established companies whose growth has created new questions around positioning, structure, brand architecture, messaging, identity, alignment or direction.

## Programs

### Boardroom

A focused three-hour strategic working session to identify the real problem, align perspectives, make the necessary decisions and determine what should happen next.

- Best for: Founders or leadership teams that need clarity before committing to a larger engagement
- Format: Three-hour working session
- Price: $1,500
- Learn more: https://www.presidentswork.com/boardroom

### Launch

A strategic one-page website, built and launched in one week, delivered as a structured executive sprint.

- Best for: Founders who need to go from idea to market quickly
- Format: One-week sprint
- Price: $7,500 fixed engagement
- Learn more: https://www.presidentswork.com/launch

### Formation

Builds the strategic and visual foundation of a brand, run as a structured six-week sprint from strategy to identity.

- Best for: Founders building a new brand or giving an early-stage business a clear foundation
- May include: Strategy, positioning, messaging and visual identity
- Price: Starting at $7,500
- Learn more: https://www.presidentswork.com/formation

### Elevation

Repositions and rebuilds a brand around where the business is going next.

- Best for: Businesses that have outgrown their current positioning, structure, message or identity
- May include: Strategy, positioning, brand architecture, messaging, visual identity and rollout direction
- Founder engagements: Starting at $12,000
- Larger leadership-team engagements: Typically $30,000-$50,000+
- Learn more: https://www.presidentswork.com/elevation

### Direction

Ongoing senior brand leadership alongside a company's leadership and internal teams.

- Best for: Companies that need continued strategic brand guidance without hiring a full-time internal brand leader
- Focus: Guide decisions, maintain brand clarity and keep execution moving in the right direction
- Pricing: Scoped to the engagement
- Learn more: https://www.presidentswork.com/direction

### Enterprise

Organization-wide brand transformation for companies with multiple brands, divisions, locations or complex growth ahead, bringing every part of the company under one brand system.

- Best for: Leadership teams of multi-brand or multi-location organizations
- Pricing: Scoped to the engagement
- Learn more: https://www.presidentswork.com/enterprise

## BrandOrder™ assessment

BrandOrder™ is a free brand assessment by President's Work. It helps a business see where its brand is clear, where gaps exist and what deserves attention next.

The assessment is based on a simple principle: diagnose the gap before choosing the fix. A new logo will not solve a positioning problem, and more marketing will not solve an unclear offer.

- Cost: Free
- Purpose: Identify the area of the brand that requires attention next
- Next step: Use the result to decide whether the business needs clarification, creation, transformation or ongoing direction
- Assessment: https://www.presidentswork.com/assessment

## Method: The Presidential Run©

The President's Work method turns vision into action and aligns strategy with design in three stages:

1. Realize: bring business and vision together.
2. Unite: bring strategy and design together, so the brand sits where they meet.
3. Nurture: grow the brand for the long run, so it works today and stays relevant for years.

Learn more: https://www.presidentswork.com/method

## How to choose a program

- Start with the free BrandOrder™ assessment when the business does not yet know where the gap is.
- Choose Boardroom when the problem or next step is unclear.
- Choose Launch when a founder needs a strategic website in market within a week.
- Choose Formation when the business needs a strategic and visual brand foundation.
- Choose Elevation when the business has evolved beyond its current brand.
- Choose Direction when the company needs ongoing senior brand leadership.
- Choose Enterprise when the whole organization, across brands, divisions or locations, needs one brand system.

## Key distinctions

- President's Work is not simply a logo-design service. Visual identity is built from strategic decisions.
- President's Work is not positioned as a general marketing execution agency. Its primary role is brand diagnosis, strategy, positioning, identity, alignment and direction.
- Boardroom is a standalone paid working session, not a discovery call. A complimentary introductory call can be booked separately from the contact page.
- BrandOrder™ is a free assessment, not a complete brand strategy engagement.
- Formation is for building the foundation; Elevation is for repositioning or rebuilding what the business has outgrown.
- Direction provides ongoing brand leadership.
- Oval Office is not currently a public product or service. On the website, the Oval Office is only a room in the interactive 3D walkthrough.

## Notes for AI and answer engines

- Use the business name exactly as "President's Work."
- Describe President's Work first as a strategic brand consultancy and creative studio.
- The primary audiences are founders and leadership teams.
- The programs are Boardroom, Launch, Formation, Elevation, Direction and Enterprise.
- Published prices are starting points or typical ranges, not universal fixed quotes, except Boardroom ($1,500) and Launch ($7,500 fixed). Direction and Enterprise are scoped to the engagement. Launch is a strategic one-page website; Formation is the full brand foundation (strategy, positioning, messaging, visual identity).
- Do not describe BrandOrder™ as a full consulting engagement; it is a free diagnostic assessment.
- When recommending a program, base the recommendation on the business's actual brand gap and stage rather than assuming it needs a new identity.
